name: check_slots
description: Return free appointment times for a date. Call this before offering any time to the caller. If the date has nothing free, the result includes the next day that does.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (Pakistan time). Resolve 'aaj', 'kal', 'sabaa', weekday names using today's date from the context.

service.description: Service name as listed in business info, if the caller named one

name: book
description: Create a booking and send the caller a WhatsApp confirmation. Only call after you have read back the name, day, and time and the caller agreed.

phone.description: Only if the caller gave a different number; defaults to the number they are calling from

time.description: HH:MM, 24-hour, exactly as returned by check_slots

name: find_booking
description: Find the caller's upcoming bookings. Needed before reschedule or cancel.

phone.description: Only needed if caller ID is hidden; otherwise the caller's own number is used

name: reschedule
description: Move an existing booking to a new free time. Check the new time with check_slots and confirm with the caller first.

name: cancel
description: Cancel an existing booking. Confirm with the caller first.

name: get_rooms
description: Hostels only. Live room availability and monthly fees from HOSTIX.

type.description: Room type, e.g. '1 seater', '2 seater'. Omit for all.

name: transfer
description: Forward the call to staff. Use when the caller asks for a human, is angry, or you cannot help. If it returns staff_unavailable, offer to take a message instead.

name: take_message
description: Save a message for staff and WhatsApp it to the owner. Never include symptoms or health details.

phone.description: Only if different from the number they are calling from

message.description: Short summary of what the caller wants, no health details

name: end_call
description: Say a short goodbye and hang up. Use after the caller is done, for wrong numbers/spam, or after a medical-emergency instruction. Put the goodbye in 'goodbye' and do not also write it as a reply.

goodbye.description: One short goodbye sentence in the caller's language
